zero_charge.assumptions: 8 equal 350F cells; ideal series bank; 20A constant; start 0V; ideal cell threshold 2V
zero_charge.limitations: No ESR, current loop, cell mismatch, switching and gate-driver startup

regen.assumptions: local 5.4mF ideal capacitor, no losses, 37.8 to 40.3V; constant 495.3W injection for 30ms
regen.limitations: Not full bus or braking response: FOC bus caps, controller, line, ESR, protection delay and load excluded

isolation_energy.limitations: No MOS fault waveform, parasitic or shutdown timing; gate signal is not proof of current interruption

candidate_BFT.limitations: Waveform RMS and single-frequency rating are not directly comparable; actual spectrum, current sharing, ESR and temperature conditions missing
